text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One big change is automation. Machines and software can now do repetitive tasks, such as sorting data or answering simple customer questions. This saves time and reduces mistakes. There are also many productivity tools that help workers plan their day, write emails, or organize meetings. However, AI is not here to replace people completely. In fact, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common. Workers use AI to get ideas and finish tasks faster, while people still make important decisions. Of course, some jobs are changing or even disappearing, so employees need to learn new skills to stay competitive.
